settings.band_provenance: Caller-supplied for the delta(E) validation (#149), pending #115: work function from the range printed for the element in the Wikipedia 'Work function' table, revision 1368612509 of 2026-08-10, which cites CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (2008), p. 12-124 (the Handbook itself was not opened); 'low'/'high' are the table's endpoints and 'mid' their mean; valence electrons per atom from the ground-state configuration (Wikipedia 'Electron configuration', Al [Ne]3s2 3p1 -> 3, Cu [Ar]3d10 4s1 -> 1; Au [Xe]4f14 5d10 6s1 -> 1, from the table of anomalous configurations of the revision 1378968605 of 2026-10-07 of that article); Fermi energy by the library's free-electron formula (Verduin 2017, Eq. 3.133) from the density of the element table.

barrier-off.label: as default, transparent boundary (no barrier), vacuum-level cutoff

cutoff-band-bottom.label: as default, cutoff measured from the band bottom, 1 eV above the Fermi level (below the vacuum level)

default.label: single-pole Penn, barrier on (mid work function), vacuum-level cutoff

mermin.label: Mermin (MELF), barrier on (mid work function), vacuum-level cutoff

penn-full.label: full Penn, barrier on (mid work function), vacuum-level cutoff

phi-high.label: as default, work function at the high end of the cited range

phi-low.label: as default, work function at the low end of the cited range

settings.elastic: Mott partial waves with the Thomas-Fermi Yukawa stand-in potential (the DHFS table is a documented gap)
settings.incidence: normal (the simulation's; the compilation does not state its sets')
